correctness.rationale: Acyclic-orientation signs factor across cactus cycle/bridge blocks. The exact conditional sign matrix on each cycle is (1+c)I−c11ᵀ, with c=(2^(ℓ−1)−1)^(−1), while the incidence-column sum vanishes. Independently, the cycle quotient of a unit cube has ℓ equal-volume tiling parallelotopes, giving its intrinsic-volume covariance by total covariance. Both measures therefore have the stated weighted-Laplacian matrices. The exact integer sign comparison for R_ℓ proves min16/7 at ℓ=4,5 and max3 on bridges; matrix equality follows from traces of positive semidefinite terms. Weighted matrix-tree theorem yields the positive determinant product. The exact-rational checker tests 13 cactus graphs and cycle lengths 3..150; infinite results rely on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The result directly compares two different canonical sampling measures on all cactus graphical zonotopes through sharp universal semidefinite bounds, complete equality classes, and an attachment-invariant generalized-variance formula. Identical sharp minimal ratio for cycles of four and five edges is a nonobvious geometric phenomenon. The facts are not merely one more computed normalizing constant, and the infinite classification serves variance comparison and geometric sampling.
